businesses.business: ambulatory surgery centers and surgical hospitals

offering_description.value: Owns and operates ambulatory surgery centers, surgical hospitals and related ancillary services, usually in partnership with physicians. Patients receive outpatient surgical, endoscopy and other procedures, paid for by insurers and government programs.

primary_services.value: outpatient surgical procedures; surgical hospital care; gastrointestinal endoscopy; ancillary services such as anesthesia, laboratory and pharmacy

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients receiving outpatient surgical and endoscopy procedures; B2B: physician partners and commercial insurers that pay for procedures; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs reimbursing patient care

end_markets.value: healthcare; outpatient surgery; gastroenterology; orthopedics; ophthalmology

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: facility fees paid by commercial insurers, Medicare, Medicaid and patients for surgical procedures; service fees: ancillary services such as anesthesia, lab and pharmacy

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs surgery centers and surgical hospitals, often jointly with physician partners, sells care to patients and payers; service provider: delivers surgical, endoscopy and ancillary care using physicians and supplies

geography_served.value: US national: Surgical facilities in about 30 US states

specialization.value: related lines: surgical facilities, surgical hospitals, endoscopy and ancillary services

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned and jointly owned surgery centers and surgical hospitals; other: physician referrals from surgeon partners and affiliated practices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed healthcare facilities, Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement rules, CMS, state licensing, fraud and abuse laws, HIPAA

notes: Exact state count and mix of ancillary services are approximate.
